sql:
-- Daily countdown editions (#76, ADR-002). A series describes one ranked list
-- (overall, one Twitch category, or one language). Each day the scheduler
-- selects one edition per enabled series from the clips created in the
-- series window, ranked by view_velocity.

CREATE TABLE countdown_series (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (slug ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$' AND char_length(slug) <= 64),
    name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 120),
    game_id TEXT CHECK (game_id IS NULL OR char_length(game_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 50),
    language TEXT CHECK (language IS NULL OR char_length(language) BETWEEN 2 AND 10),
    size INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 10 CHECK (size BETWEEN 1 AND 50),
    window_hours INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 24 CHECK (window_hours BETWEEN 1 AND 168),
    per_broadcaster_cap INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (per_broadcaster_cap BETWEEN 1 AND 10),
    selection_hour_utc INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 12 CHECK (selection_hour_utc BETWEEN 0 AND 23),
    priority INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,
    enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

COMMENT ON COLUMN countdown_series.priority IS
    'Series with a lower priority select first each day; a clip goes to at most one edition per day';

CREATE TABLE countdown_editions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    series_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES countdown_series(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    edition_date DATE NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'selected'
        CHECK (status IN ('selected', 'fetching', 'rendering', 'rendered', 'published', 'failed')),
    window_start TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    window_end TIMESTAMP NOT NULL CHECK (window_end > window_start),
    failure_reason TEXT CHECK (failure_reason IS NULL OR char_length(failure_reason) <= 500),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    UNIQUE (series_id, edition_date),
    UNIQUE (id, edition_date)
);

CREATE INDEX countdown_editions_date_idx ON countdown_editions (edition_date DESC);

-- edition_date is repeated here so the database itself guarantees that one
-- clip appears in at most one edition per day.
CREATE TABLE countdown_edition_clips (
    edition_id UUID NOT NULL,
    edition_date DATE NOT NULL,
    position INT NOT NULL CHECK (position >= 1),
    clip_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES clips(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    view_velocity DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (edition_id, position),
    UNIQUE (edition_date, clip_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (edition_id, edition_date) REFERENCES countdown_editions (id, edition_date) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE INDEX countdown_edition_clips_clip_idx ON countdown_edition_clips (clip_id);

-- A broadcaster or a single clip left out of every future edition: on
-- request, after a DMCA notice, or after a takedown or platform claim.
CREATE TABLE countdown_exclusions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    broadcaster_id TEXT CHECK (broadcaster_id IS NULL OR char_length(broadcaster_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 50),
    clip_id UUID REFERENCES clips(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    reason TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('request', 'dmca', 'takedown')),
    source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('admin', 'self_service')),
    note TEXT CHECK (note IS NULL OR char_length(note) <= 500),
    created_by UUID REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    CHECK ((broadcaster_id IS NULL) <> (clip_id IS NULL))
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX countdown_exclusions_broadcaster_idx ON countdown_exclusions (broadcaster_id) WHERE broadcaster_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX countdown_exclusions_clip_idx ON countdown_exclusions (clip_id) WHERE clip_id IS NOT NULL;

name: 000150_add_countdown_media.up.sql
sql:
-- Media fetched for countdown editions (#77, ADR-002). Files live only on the
-- render host and are deleted within 24 hours; these rows keep what was
-- fetched, from where, and its checksum.

ALTER TABLE countdown_editions DROP CONSTRAINT countdown_editions_status_check;
ALTER TABLE countdown_editions ADD CONSTRAINT countdown_editions_status_check
    CHECK (status IN ('selected', 'fetching', 'fetched', 'rendering', 'rendered', 'published', 'failed'));

CREATE INDEX countdown_editions_status_idx ON countdown_editions (status, edition_date);

CREATE TABLE countdown_edition_media (
    edition_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES countdown_editions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    clip_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES clips(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('helix', 'player')),
    file_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (char_length(file_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    bytes BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (bytes > 0),
    duration_seconds DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL CHECK (duration_seconds > 0),
    width INT NOT NULL CHECK (width > 0),
    height INT NOT NULL CHECK (height > 0),
    fetched_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    PRIMARY KEY (edition_id, clip_id)
);

CREATE INDEX countdown_edition_media_undeleted_idx ON countdown_edition_media (fetched_at) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;

-- Clips whose media could not be fetched. Selection and backfill leave them
-- out of every edition on the same date.
CREATE TABLE countdown_edition_skips (
    edition_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES countdown_editions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    edition_date DATE NOT NULL,
    clip_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES clips(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    reason TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (char_length(reason) BETWEEN 1 AND 500),
    skipped_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    PRIMARY KEY (edition_id, clip_id)
);

CREATE INDEX countdown_edition_skips_date_idx ON countdown_edition_skips (edition_date, clip_id);

name: 000151_add_countdown_renders.up.sql
sql:
-- Rendered countdown videos, Shorts and thumbnails (#78). The files live on
-- the render host until they are published (#79) or expire; these rows keep
-- their checksums.

ALTER TABLE countdown_series
    ADD COLUMN shorts_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (shorts_count BETWEEN 0 AND 10);

COMMENT ON COLUMN countdown_series.shorts_count IS
    'How many top clips of each edition also get a 9:16 Short';

CREATE TABLE countdown_renders (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    edition_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES countdown_editions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('countdown', 'short', 'thumbnail')),
    clip_id UUID REFERENCES clips(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    file_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (char_length(file_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    bytes BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (bytes > 0),
    duration_seconds DOUBLE PRECISION CHECK (duration_seconds IS NULL OR duration_seconds > 0),
    rendered_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    CHECK ((kind = 'short') = (clip_id IS NOT NULL)),
    UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (edition_id, kind, clip_id)
);

CREATE INDEX countdown_renders_undeleted_idx ON countdown_renders (rendered_at) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;

name: 000152_add_webhook_discord_target.up.sql
sql:
-- Discord delivery for outbound webhooks (#83). A subscription's target type
-- decides the request body: the signed JSON event for "generic", a Discord
-- message with embeds for "discord".
ALTER TABLE webhook_subscriptions
    ADD COLUMN target_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'generic'
        CHECK (target_type IN ('generic', 'discord'));

-- The daily and countdown events are queued by schedulers and workers that
-- may run more than once for the same day or edition; one delivery per
-- subscription and event keeps them from posting twice.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_webhook_deliveries_once
    ON webhook_deliveries (subscription_id, event_type, event_id)
    WHERE event_type IN ('countdown.published', 'daily.top_clips');

name: 000153_add_countdown_youtube_uploads.up.sql
sql:
-- YouTube publishing of countdown renders (#79). An edition moves from
-- "rendered" to "publishing" while the worker uploads it, then to
-- "published". Each uploaded render is recorded once, so a retried edition
-- does not upload a file twice.
ALTER TABLE countdown_editions DROP CONSTRAINT countdown_editions_status_check;
ALTER TABLE countdown_editions ADD CONSTRAINT countdown_editions_status_check
    CHECK (status IN ('selected', 'fetching', 'fetched', 'rendering', 'rendered', 'publishing', 'published', 'failed'));

CREATE TABLE countdown_uploads (
    render_id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES countdown_renders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    edition_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES countdown_editions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('countdown', 'short')),
    clip_id UUID REFERENCES clips(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    youtube_video_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (youtube_video_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{6,20}$'),
    privacy_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (privacy_status IN ('private', 'unlisted', 'public')),
    publish_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    uploaded_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX countdown_uploads_edition_idx ON countdown_uploads (edition_id);

-- One YouTube playlist per series, created on its first upload.
CREATE TABLE countdown_youtube_playlists (
    series_id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES countdown_series(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    playlist_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (playlist_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,64}$'),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

name: 000154_add_broadcaster_countdown_controls.up.sql
sql:
-- Broadcaster controls for countdowns (#75).

-- A self-service exclusion records which consent text the broadcaster saw.
ALTER TABLE countdown_exclusions
    ADD COLUMN consent_text_version TEXT CHECK (consent_text_version IS NULL OR char_length(consent_text_version) BETWEEN 1 AND 40);

-- Uploaded videos that show a clip excluded after upload must be removed or
-- edited within 7 days. The task list is computed from countdown_uploads and
-- the exclusions; this table records which tasks an admin resolved.
CREATE TABLE countdown_removals (
    render_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES countdown_renders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    clip_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES clips(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    resolution TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (resolution IN ('removed', 'edited', 'kept')),
    note TEXT CHECK (note IS NULL OR char_length(note) <= 500),
    resolved_by UUID REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    PRIMARY KEY (render_id, clip_id)
);

-- "Feature my clips": the broadcaster granted channel:manage:clips so clpr
-- can fetch their clips through Helix and feature them.
CREATE TABLE broadcaster_feature_optins (
    broadcaster_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (char_length(broadcaster_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 50),
    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (char_length(scope) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    consent_text_version TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (char_length(consent_text_version) BETWEEN 1 AND 40),
    granted_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX broadcaster_feature_optins_user_idx ON broadcaster_feature_optins (user_id);

name: 000155_add_countdown_min_size.up.sql
000156_add_countdown_upload_stats.up.sql
sql:
-- YouTube view counts for countdown uploads (#84). The countdown worker
-- refreshes them with videos.list. youtube_privacy_status is the video's
-- privacy on YouTube now, which differs from privacy_status once a scheduled
-- upload goes public. youtube_missing marks a video YouTube no longer returns.
ALTER TABLE countdown_uploads
    ADD COLUMN view_count BIGINT CHECK (view_count IS NULL OR view_count >= 0),
    ADD COLUMN youtube_privacy_status TEXT
        CHECK (youtube_privacy_status IS NULL OR youtube_privacy_status IN ('private', 'unlisted', 'public')),
    ADD COLUMN youtube_missing BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    ADD COLUMN stats_refreshed_at TIMESTAMPTZ;

CREATE INDEX countdown_uploads_stats_idx ON countdown_uploads (stats_refreshed_at NULLS FIRST, uploaded_at)
    WHERE youtube_missing = FALSE;

name: 000157_add_clip_packs.up.sql
sql:
-- Weekly clip packs for broadcasters who feature their clips (#86). Each
-- Monday the countdown worker picks a broadcaster's top clips of the past
-- week, renders them as captioned 9:16 files and a 16:9 highlight reel, and
-- zips them on the render host. The zip is served by expiring link and
-- deleted 7 days after it is ready.
CREATE TABLE clip_packs (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    broadcaster_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (char_length(broadcaster_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 50),
    broadcaster_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (char_length(broadcaster_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 100),
    week_start DATE NOT NULL CHECK (EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM week_start) = 1),
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
        CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'building', 'ready', 'failed', 'expired')),
    file_name TEXT CHECK (file_name IS NULL OR char_length(file_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    sha256 TEXT CHECK (sha256 IS NULL OR sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    bytes BIGINT CHECK (bytes IS NULL OR bytes > 0),
    clip_count INT CHECK (clip_count IS NULL OR clip_count >= 0),
    failure_reason TEXT CHECK (failure_reason IS NULL OR char_length(failure_reason) <= 500),
    ready_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    UNIQUE (broadcaster_id, week_start),
    CHECK (status <> 'ready' OR (file_name IS NOT NULL AND sha256 IS NOT NULL AND expires_at IS NOT NULL))
);

CREATE INDEX clip_packs_status_idx ON clip_packs (status, created_at);
CREATE INDEX clip_packs_files_idx ON clip_packs (expires_at) WHERE file_name IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL;

CREATE TABLE clip_pack_clips (
    pack_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES clip_packs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    position INT NOT NULL CHECK (position >= 1),
    clip_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES clips(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    PRIMARY KEY (pack_id, position),
    UNIQUE (pack_id, clip_id)
);

name: 000158_add_countdown_transcripts.up.sql
sql:
-- Transcript search (#87). The render host transcribes every countdown clip
-- while its media is on hand, not only the clips that get a Short, and
-- stores the English transcript for search. A transcript from the
-- broadcaster's own authorization is kept over one from the render host.
ALTER TABLE clip_transcripts DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS clip_transcripts_source_check;
ALTER TABLE clip_transcripts ADD CONSTRAINT clip_transcripts_source_check
    CHECK (source IN ('twitch_authorized_whisper', 'countdown_render_whisper'));

-- Whisper runs on clpr's own hosts, so its cost is compute time. One row per
-- day and source adds up the clips, their audio length and the time spent.
CREATE TABLE transcription_usage_daily (
    day DATE NOT NULL,
    source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('twitch_authorized_whisper', 'countdown_render_whisper')),
    clips INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (clips >= 0),
    transcripts INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (transcripts >= 0),
    audio_seconds DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (audio_seconds >= 0),
    compute_seconds DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (compute_seconds >= 0),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    PRIMARY KEY (day, source)
);

-- The API copies new and changed transcripts into the clips search index;
-- search_indexed_at is the transcript version it copied last.
ALTER TABLE clip_transcripts ADD COLUMN search_indexed_at TIMESTAMPTZ;
CREATE INDEX clip_transcripts_search_pending_idx ON clip_transcripts (updated_at)
    WHERE search_indexed_at IS NULL OR search_indexed_at < updated_at;

name: 000159_add_streamer_digest.up.sql
sql:
-- Weekly streamer digest email (#85). Broadcasters who feature their clips
-- get one email a week with their top clips, countdown placements and their
-- clip pack. notify_streamer_digest is its own preference and unsubscribe.
ALTER TABLE notification_preferences
    ADD COLUMN notify_streamer_digest BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE;

-- One row per user and week, written before the email is sent, so no digest
-- goes out twice even with several API replicas.
CREATE TABLE streamer_digest_sends (
    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    week_start DATE NOT NULL CHECK (EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM week_start) = 1),
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sending' CHECK (status IN ('sending', 'sent', 'skipped', 'failed')),
    reason TEXT CHECK (reason IS NULL OR char_length(reason) <= 500),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, week_start)
);

name: 000160_add_countdown_clip_room_series.up.sql
sql:
-- Clip room series (#88): a countdown series can take a streamer's clip
-- room as its source. Its editions are the room's approved clips, in the
-- room's order, instead of the fastest-rising clips. If the room is deleted
-- the series keeps its source and its editions fail with a reason.
ALTER TABLE countdown_series
    ADD COLUMN source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'velocity' CHECK (source IN ('velocity', 'clip_room')),
    ADD COLUMN clip_room_id UUID REFERENCES streamer_clip_rooms(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;

COMMENT ON COLUMN countdown_series.source IS
    'velocity: the fastest-rising clips of the window; clip_room: the approved clips of clip_room_id, in room order';

CREATE INDEX streamer_clip_room_items_room_approved_idx
    ON streamer_clip_room_items (room_id, approved_at)
    WHERE status = 'approved' AND clip_id IS NOT NULL;

name: 000161_add_search_transcription.up.sql
000162_add_clip_vod_fields.up.sql
sql:
-- Helix returns, for each clip, the past broadcast (VOD) it came from and
-- where in it the clip starts. Both change: the offset is empty until Twitch
-- processes the VOD, and both go empty when the VOD is deleted. Every import
-- and refresh stores the current values.
ALTER TABLE clips
    ADD COLUMN twitch_video_id TEXT CHECK (twitch_video_id IS NULL OR twitch_video_id ~ '^[0-9]{1,20}$'),
    ADD COLUMN twitch_vod_offset INT CHECK (twitch_vod_offset IS NULL OR twitch_vod_offset >= 0);

-- Countdown media may come from the VOD, with a few seconds of the
-- broadcast before and after the clip (ADR-004).
ALTER TABLE countdown_edition_media DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS countdown_edition_media_source_check;
ALTER TABLE countdown_edition_media ADD CONSTRAINT countdown_edition_media_source_check
    CHECK (source IN ('helix', 'player', 'vod'));
